summary: A farm management app with a navigation dropdown menu containing: Dashboard, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time sections.

existing_features.title: Replace the flat row of navigation buttons (Dashboard, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time) in the Dashboard with a single dropdown menu trigger. Clicking the trigger opens a dropdown listing all sections; selecting an item navigates to that tab and closes the dropdown.

new_feature_requests.summary: Put navigation buttons (Dashboard, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time) into a dropdown menu
